player_prompt.intro:
Keddaɣ ad tekkiɣ {player_id} ɣ **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Tafkeḍ tirir nnek **[macro  micro]** (sin iḍan 0-8):
• *macro*  = ayyawen mini-board i teddakkel
• *micro* = ayyawen takkast n wakal n wemmini-board
Amedya `[7 8]` ➜ ṣekk tirir nnek ɣ mini-board 7, takkast 8, d
ɛawen-d akken iɣallen nnek ad teddakkel ɣ mini-board 8 deffir.

Keddaɣ ad tekkiɣ `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ⵉⵇⵏⴻⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵓⵎⵓⵙⵙⵓ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵏⴰⵡ [macro micro] ⴷ ⵉⵎⴹⴰⵏ 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⵏⴷⵉⵛⵙ ⴽⵓ ⵢⴰⵏ ⴳⵔ 0 ⴰⵔ 8.
invalid_move.index_out_of_range: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴳ ⵓⴱⴰⵔⴰⵣ ⵏ ⵓⵙⵉⵔⴰ, ⵏⵖⴷ ⵜⴰⴳⴳⴰⵢⵜ.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Amɣar ara ad iraqqi deg uɣlisi aɣzzaf azwar.

game_action.played: Amɣar {player_id} iraqqi deg uɣlisi aɣzzaf {macro_idx}, taka {micro_idx} (adrar {row}, tuska {col}). Amɣar {opponent_id} ara ad iraqqi deg {nxt_txt}.
